Sisyphe is the traditional sediment transport module in TELEMAC, which has largely been replaced by the more unified Gaia module. Gaia is based on the historical module SISYPHE, with a large number of improvements, corrections, and optimizations implemented. Gaia’s unified framework efficiently manages different sediment classes, sand-mud mixtures, and both 2D and 3D spatial dimensions. To get specifications beyond the features presented here in the TELEMAC documentation and the TELEMAC forum, it is useful to know the SISYPHE heritage.
